panels.description: Underlying Prometheus series for the server-wide stub_status, connection, and telemetry graphs. NGINX stub_status has no virtual-host dimension, so these infrastructure metrics intentionally do not use the NGINX hostname filter.
panels.title: Server metric detail list

panels.description: Up to 100 client addresses observed in the selected range. Country and city are resolved locally from DB-IP City Lite; city is approximate.

targets.expr: topk(100, sum by (remote_addr, country_code, country, city) (count_over_time({job="nginx-access",instance=~"$instance"} | json | host=~"${host:pipe}" | method=~"${method:pipe}" | status=~"${response_class:pipe}" | __error__="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Client IPs

panels.description: Requests grouped by locally resolved country over the selected range.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (country_code, country) (count_over_time({job="nginx-access",instance=~"$instance"} | json | host=~"${host:pipe}" | method=~"${method:pipe}" | status=~"${response_class:pipe}" | __error__="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Top countries

panels.description: Request volume by the locally resolved approximate client location. Unknown and private addresses are excluded from the map.

targets.expr: topk(100, sum by (country_code, country, city, latitude, longitude) (count_over_time({job="nginx-access",instance=~"$instance"} | json | host=~"${host:pipe}" | method=~"${method:pipe}" | status=~"${response_class:pipe}" | country_code!="ZZ" | __error__="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Client request world map

panels.description: Recent access records for the selected NGINX hostname. Each line includes the real client IP, request path, timings, status, and transferred bytes.

targets.expr: {job="nginx-access",instance=~"$instance"} | json | host=~"${host:pipe}" | method=~"${method:pipe}" | status=~"${response_class:pipe}" | __error__="" | line_format "{{.remote_addr}}  {{.host}}  {{.method}} {{.uri}}  {{.status}}  rt={{.request_time}}s urt={{.upstream_time}}s sent={{.bytes_sent}} received={{.bytes_received}}"

panels.title: Recent client connections

panels.description: DB-IP City Lite attribution required by CC BY 4.0.

options.content: IP geolocation by [DB-IP](https://db-ip.com). City and coordinates are approximate; VPNs, proxies, mobile networks, and anycast can identify an exit point rather than the user.

panels.description: Up to 20 P95 request and 20 P95 upstream latencies by endpoint over the selected range. The endpoint combines the NGINX hostname and path; paths remain query-time data in Loki.

targets.expr: topk(20, quantile_over_time(0.95, {job="nginx-access",instance=~"$instance"} | json | host=~"${host:pipe}" | method=~"${method:pipe}" | status=~"${response_class:pipe}" | label_format endpoint="{{.host}} {{.uri}}" | __error__="" | unwrap request_time [$__range]) by (endpoint))

topk(20, quantile_over_time(0.95, {job="nginx-access",instance=~"$instance"} | json | host=~"${host:pipe}" | method=~"${method:pipe}" | status=~"${response_class:pipe}" | label_format endpoint="{{.host}} {{.uri}}" | __error__="" | unwrap upstream_time [$__range]) by (endpoint))

panels.title: P95 latency by endpoint

panels.description: The 20 NGINX hostname and path pairs with the highest current request rate, filtered by the selected method and response class. Calculated at query time from structured access logs.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (host, uri) (rate({job="nginx-access",instance=~"$instance"} | json | host=~"${host:pipe}" | method=~"${method:pipe}" | status=~"${response_class:pipe}" | __error__="" [$__interval])))

panels.title: Request rate by endpoint

panels.description: The 20 NGINX hostname and path pairs with the highest 5xx response ratio in the current rate window.

targets.expr: topk(20, 100 * sum by (host, uri) (rate({job="nginx-access",instance=~"$instance"} | json | host=~"${host:pipe}" | method=~"${method:pipe}" | status=~"${response_class:pipe}" | status=~"5.." | __error__="" [$__interval])) / sum by (host, uri) (rate({job="nginx-access",instance=~"$instance"} | json | host=~"${host:pipe}" | method=~"${method:pipe}" | status=~"${response_class:pipe}" | __error__="" [$__interval])))
